summary: Critical Metals Corp. filed a 6-K confirming completion of its acquisition of ASX-listed European Lithium Ltd. via two interdependent Australian schemes of arrangement, originally agreed May 18, 2026. Court approval followed October 26 and effectiveness October 27; the November 5, 2026 implementation date made European Lithium a wholly owned subsidiary. Critical Metals issued 90,539,994 ordinary shares, including 78,414,558 under the share scheme at a 0.045-for-one ratio. Post-deal, 194,219,631 shares are outstanding, with European Lithium's 45,536,338 shares rights-suspended and treated as treasury. Watch integration, warrant overhang and Nasdaq price triggers.
